description:
All this month, Walter will be reviewing and reliving the first batch of episodes that darkened our imagination. One video per day all October long! Every new review will debut here at midnight central time. Turn off the lights, grab a flashlight and join the mania. This Halloween season we honor Are you Afraid of the Dark and the Midnight Society with the first ever Midnight Mania!

Follow Walter on Twitter - https://x.com/WalterCulture

Follow Walter on Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/walterculture88

Sub to Walter's YouTube channel - https://www.youtube.com/@UCcqxGkBymiRUuHNF6sQBatA 

Are You Afraid of the Dark? is an American children's horror anthology television series created by D. J. MacHale and Ned Kandel. The original series aired on Nickelodeon in the United States from August 15, 1992, to February 3, 1996, and also on YTV in Canada.
